description: This Java interface defines a Metrics collector for tracking device connections, telemetry, command messages, and related metrics within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: Metrics
classes.description: Interface for collecting and reporting various device and message metrics in the system.

methods.name: incrementConnections
methods.description: Reports a new authenticated device connection for a tenant.

methods.name: decrementConnections
methods.description: Reports a closed authenticated device connection for a tenant.

methods.name: incrementUnauthenticatedConnections
methods.description: Reports a new unauthenticated device connection.

methods.name: decrementUnauthenticatedConnections
methods.description: Reports a closed unauthenticated device connection.

methods.name: getNumberOfConnections
methods.description: Returns the total number of current connections (authenticated and unauthenticated).

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Starts and returns a new timing sample.

methods.name: reportTelemetry
methods.description: Reports telemetry or event messages received from devices, including processing outcome, payload size, and optional TTD status.

methods.name: reportCommand
methods.description: Reports command and control messages transferred to/from devices, including processing outcome and payload size.
